grade.primary_choice: Build it inside the Rails monolith as a namespaced admin area
red_flags_hit: Missing CSV/formula injection when exporting customer-controlled strings that will be opened in Excel
unsupported_claims: Retool necessarily means a SaaS holds production database credentials (self-hosted Retool and agent-based setups exist)
grade.notes: A thorough, well-grounded answer: it says to build in the monolith and covers read replicas, rollups, async S3 exports, SSO with roles, audit logging and Postgres search, all tied to the team's skills and on-call priorities. Its only real gap is that it never mentions CSV formula injection; it also doesn't explicitly cover rate limits or narrowing exported data to what CS needs.
